# arch-crew

> A cross-agent package of four architectural-decision skills. Each helps you choose an architecture,
> pattern, or testing strategy for new work (a short selection interview) or audit existing code (a
> review against a catalog), and records the decision as an ADR or review report. The bias
> throughout: recommend the least architecture that meets the requirement, and name the cost of
> every pick.

## Skills

- [decide-architecture](skills/decide-architecture/SKILL.md): software architecture — structure, topology, data, overlays. Greenfield → composed stack + ADR; existing code → review + targeted moves.
- [design-patterns](skills/design-patterns/SKILL.md): GoF + Python-idiomatic design patterns. Greenfield → one recommended pattern + its Pythonic form; existing code → smell-to-pattern review.
- [agentic-patterns](skills/agentic-patterns/SKILL.md): LLM-agent systems — autonomy level, reasoning loop, memory, governance, multi-agent topology. Greenfield → layered design + ADR; existing code → seven-defect review.
- [test-patterns](skills/test-patterns/SKILL.md): testing strategy across three evidence dimensions — quality practices, deterministic executable testing (unit/integration/contract/E2E), and stochastic evaluation (data/ML/LLM) — plus one cross-cutting oracle-independence guardrail. Greenfield → risk-led evidence portfolio + ADR; existing test code → suite review + one highest-leverage rebalancing move. Routes questions like "unit vs integration vs E2E", "do we need contract tests", "pyramid or trophy", "why is my suite flaky or slow", "do I need QA", "how do I test this pipeline / model / agent", "are these AI-generated tests any good". Not for implementing one ordinary test.

## Reference knowledge (per skill)

- [architecture decision tree](skills/decide-architecture/references/decision-tree.md) and [catalog](skills/decide-architecture/references/catalog.md)
- [design-patterns decision tree](skills/design-patterns/references/decision-tree.md) and [catalog](skills/design-patterns/references/catalog.md)
- [agentic decision tree](skills/agentic-patterns/references/decision-tree.md) and [catalog](skills/agentic-patterns/references/catalog.md)
- [testing decision tree](skills/test-patterns/references/decision-tree.md) (risk-led interview with asymmetric escalation gates), [catalog](skills/test-patterns/references/catalog.md) (quality practices, levels, shapes, techniques, cross-level concerns, review anti-patterns), [evaluation overlay](skills/test-patterns/references/evaluation.md) (data / ML / LLM and agent evaluation), and [oracle guardrail](skills/test-patterns/references/oracles.md) (generated-test trust)

## Install

### Claude Code

- `/plugin marketplace add AdamKrysztopa/architectural-decisions`
- `/plugin install arch-crew`

This original Claude Code path is backward-compatible.

### Codex

- `codex plugin marketplace add AdamKrysztopa/architectural-decisions`
- `codex plugin add arch-crew@arch-crew`

## Packaging

`skills/`, docs, and examples are the canonical shared content. Thin target adapters in
`builders/` generate committed, target-only package trees in `build/<target>/`; do not edit those
artifacts by hand. Claude Code and Codex are currently supported targets. See
[the package build guide](docs/building-packages.md) for maintainer workflow.
